name: Gopala Krishna
reason: Krishna as cowherd; IAST matches Devanagari word by word.

name: Uma Shankar
reason: Shiva, lord of Uma; common traditional name.

name: Ganga Prasad
reason: Gift of the Ganga; common family name.

name: Raghu Ram
reason: Rama of the Raghu line; used by families.

name: Murali Krishna
reason: Krishna with the flute; very common.

name: Brij Kishore
reason: Youth of Braj; IAST vraja is the correct Sanskrit form of Brij.

name: Braj Bhushan
reason: Ornament of Braj; distinct from Brij Kishore, spelling variant Braj/Brij only in first word.
